continuity: Mungyeong is a Level 6 medical apprentice from a humble military household; his parents were killed on the Yangtze more than ten years ago, and Mu Song saved him at that time.
Mungyeong interrupted Mu Song's execution of Hwang Tae-gu, requested that Hwang live, and asked that his martial arts be crippled and that he be punished under Yangtze River Channel League law.
Mu Song destroyed Hwang Tae-gu's dantian and martial arts, immobilized him with Pressure-Point Strike, and ordered that he be transported to the League headquarters for punishment.
All twenty passengers attacked by Hwang Tae-gu's river-bandits survived, though some were injured; Mungyeong's improvised naval tactics were chiefly responsible for buying them time.
Mungyeong has boarded Mu Song's ship while traveling toward Xi'an.
plot: Mungyeong, a young Level 6 medical apprentice whose parents were killed by Hwang Tae-gu and whose life Mu Song once saved, asks Mu Song to spare Hwang and punish him under League law rather than kill him. Mu Song destroys Hwang's dantian and immobilizes him for transport to League headquarters; Mungyeong's earlier tactics saved all twenty passengers, and after learning that Mu Song is sailing toward Xi'an, he boards the ship.

Mungyeong reveals that he saved the passengers by turning the boat into an uncontrollable drifting obstacle, using deck boards as shields and breaking the mast and sails to buy time against the river-bandits.
translation_decisions: Render 문경 as Mungyeong, 의생 as medical apprentice, 인의대협 as Great Hero of Benevolence and Righteousness, 맹규 as League regulations, 본단 as League headquarters, and 기해혈 as qi-sea acupoint.
Preserve the distinction between destroying Hwang Tae-gu's dantian and killing him; he remains alive but has lost his martial arts.
Render Mungyeong's elaborate promise to repay the favor as a Jeong Mong-ju allusion and retain the explanatory footnote.

active_continuity: Mu Song is the Lord of Water Dragon Stronghold, a Peak master and the Seafaring King's second martial Disciple; he belongs to the moderate faction of the Yangtze River Channel League and controls major Yangtze river traffic in Sichuan.
Mu Song's fast ship is carrying Taekyung's party and Mungyeong toward Xi'an.
Jeok Cheongang remains unconscious on the party's pack frame and must be treated within his remaining window.
Taekyung possesses the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng.
Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau's Young Bureau Head and is investigating escort captains who aided Heo Jun's scheme.
Song Ilseom will remain for one month to help Ju Hwaran purge the bureau's traitors, then seek an elixir for Ju Hogun in Xianyang.
The Zhongnan Sect's other conspirators and the organizers behind the broader scheme remain unidentified.
The identity of the person who sought the Guangdong Chen Family's Peak martial arts and the fate of the family's other members remain unresolved.
Hwang Tae-gu, a former Sichuan river-bandit power displaced by Mu Song, has lost his dantian and martial arts and is being transported to Yangtze River Channel League headquarters for punishment.
Cheongpung is trying to develop the resolve to endure the violence of the Murim.
Mungyeong is a resolute, compassionate medical apprentice whose parents were killed by Hwang Tae-gu and whose life was previously saved by Mu Song.
open_questions: Where is the Divine Physician in Sichuan, and can Jeok Cheongang be treated within the remaining window?
What punishment will Yangtze River Channel League headquarters impose on Hwang Tae-gu, and can his connections still affect his fate?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how will Song Ilseom's Guangdong Chen lineage affect the bureau and the wider Murim?
How will the Zhongnan Sect's Sect Leader and Elders respond to the exposed scheme, and what consequences will Hwangbo Eom's defeat, Heo Jun's betrayal, and Zhongnan's coercion cause within the Murim?
Who sought the Guangdong Chen Family's Peak martial arts, and what happened to the other members of the family?
temporary_decisions: Use Captain Song for 송 표두.
Use Great Hero Jin for 진 대협 when Ju Hwaran addresses Taekyung.
Use Lady for 여사 in Taekyung's joking sobriquet for Kim Jeonghee.
Render 선화아 as Ship-Fire Boy, 무송 as Mu Song, 채주 as Stronghold Lord, 의생 as medical apprentice, and 기해혈 as qi-sea acupoint.
Render 선장님 as Captain in the ship context, distinct from the established martial term 선장 rendered as Zen staffs.

profile_creations.personality: Compassionate, resolute, resourceful, and calm under extreme pressure.
profile_creations.relationships: Mu Song saved him after his parents were killed on the Yangtze; Hwang Tae-gu killed his parents, but Mungyeong asked that Hwang live and be punished under League law.
profile_creations.role: A young medical apprentice from a humble military household who is currently traveling toward Xi'an.
profile_creations.voice: Initially timid and deferential, he becomes clear, composed, and eloquent when arguing for mercy and justice.
